content_sections.heading: BEL Havildar Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: Notification Release Date: 25.08.2026 Start Date for Applying Online: 25.08.2026 Last Date for Applying Online: 14.09.2026 Cut-off Date for Age, Qualification and Experience: 01.08.2026 Date of Physical Endurance Test and Written Test: Will be intimated later

content_sections.heading: BEL Havildar Vacancy 2026 Details
content_sections.text: BEL has announced a total of 5 vacancies for the post of Havildar (Security) at its Kotdwar Unit. The category-wise vacancy breakup is given below. The reservation is 100% for Ex-servicemen. The abbreviations used are: UR = Unreserved, OBC (NCL) = Other Backward Classes (Non-Creamy Layer), SC = Scheduled Caste, EWS = Economically Weaker Section.

content_sections.heading: BEL Havildar Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must be citizens of India. Candidates should possess the qualification of SSLC (10th Pass) along with 15 years of service experience in the Indian Armed Forces, as on 01.08.2026. Candidates should have an "Exemplary" or "Very Good" service record. Medical category should be "AYE" / "SHAPE-I". Fire training and possession of a driving license is desirable. Registration at the District Sainik Welfare Board is mandatory. Ability to read, write and speak Hindi/English is essential. Candidates must possess Experience Certificates/Discharge Certificates/Documents issued by the previous and present employer clearly indicating the period of employment and post held. The upper age limit as on 01.08.2026 is 43 years for Unreserved (UR) category candidates. Candidates seeking age relaxation for Havildar (Security) posts must attach a copy of the necessary certificate(s) along with the application and submit it in original at the time of the Physical Endurance Test/Written Test and at any subsequent stage for verification. To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.

content_sections.heading: BEL Havildar 2026 Salary Structure
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will be placed in Wage Group-III / Career Path-III with the following pay scale, along with admissible allowances as per company rules. In addition to Basic Pay, selected candidates will be entitled to other allowances such as Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance, Perquisites at the rate of 30% of the annual basic pay, reimbursement of medical expenses, Group Insurance, PF, Pension, and Gratuity, as per company rules.

content_sections.heading: BEL Havildar Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates meeting the eligibility criteria will be shortlisted for the selection process, which consists of the following stages: Physical Endurance Test: Eligible candidates will undergo a Physical Endurance Test at Kotdwar, Uttarakhand. A self-declaration form for fitness and willingness will need to be submitted at the time of the test, and the form will be provided by BEL on the day of the test. Written Test: Candidates who qualify in the Physical Endurance Test will be shortlisted for the Written Test, also to be held at Kotdwar, Uttarakhand. The date of the Physical Endurance Test and Written Test will be intimated later.

content_sections.heading: BEL Havildar Required Documents 2026
content_sections.text: Applications should be accompanied by the following scanned self-attested documents: Recent color passport-size photograph SSLC marks card and any other valid document as proof of date of birth Certificate in the prescribed format for candidates belonging to SC/OBC-NCL/EWS/ST categories No Objection Certificate from the present employer, if employed in Government/Semi-Government/PSU (if applicable) Experience Certificate/Discharge Certificate, if applicable, clearly indicating medical category, date of discharge, and exemplary/very good records (SHAPE-I or equivalent) Documentary proof of Medical Category, Character and probable date of discharge, for candidates presently employed in the Armed Forces and yet to be discharged Document of Registration and number from the District Sainik Welfare Board

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for BEL Havildar Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can apply online for the BEL Havildar (Security) Recruitment 2026 by following the steps below: Visit the official BEL website, www.bel-india.in , or use the direct application link provided below. Read the instructions for filling the online application form carefully before proceeding. Fill in all the required details in the online application form accurately. Upload the necessary scanned self-attested documents as specified in the notification. Submit the online application form before the last date, 14.09.2026. Take a printout of the submitted application form for future reference. Note that no manual/offline application will be entertained.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in BEL Havildar Security Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 5 vacancies for the post of Havildar (Security) at the Kotdwar Unit of Bharat Electronics Limited.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for BEL Havildar Security Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online is 14.09.2026. The online application link opened on 25.08.2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the eligibility for BEL Havildar Security post?
faq.answer: Candidates should be SSLC (10th) pass with 15 years of service experience in the Indian Armed Forces, as on 01.08.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for BEL Havildar Security Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 43 years as on 01.08.2026 for UR candidates, with 3 years' relaxation for OBC-NCL and 5 years' relaxation for SC candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for BEL Havildar Security Recruitment?
faq.answer: Selection is through a Physical Endurance Test followed by a Written Test, both conducted at Kotdwar, Uttarakhand.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for BEL Havildar Security post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will be placed in WG-III/CP-III pay scale of Rs. 20,500-3%-79,000/- plus admissible allowances.
